'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Nicolae Borota LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nicolae Borota]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Nicolae Borota (JediBorota)
* '''Deck name:''' Lightbringer
* '''Username:''' JediBorota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
